source.name: Genoa CFC, 'Pulsee Luce e Gas front jersey sponsor '25/26'
source.quote: firmano un nuovo capitolo di un’alleanza, nata nel 2023, che vedrà Pulsee Luce e Gas Front Jersey Sponsor del Genoa
source.note: The club's announcement of the renewal for 2025/26; it dates the alliance to 2023 (first deal for 2023/24 and 2024/25). The partnership continues in 2026/27 ('Pulsee Luce e Gas – Front Jersey Sponsor del Genoa', genoacfc.it, 2026-10-02).

note: Front-jersey deal since 2023/24, renewed for 2025/26 and running through 2026/27. No reported deal value found.
